name: Cheat
tagline: Play your cards face down and lie with a straight face. Call Cheat! when you smell a bluff.
rulesSummary: Also called Bullshit or I Doubt It. All the cards are dealt (two decks for seven or more players).
In turn, put one or more cards face down on the pile and say they are the next rank: aces, then twos, threes … kings, then aces again. You don't have to tell the truth.
Before the next player plays, anyone may call Cheat! The cards are turned up: if any isn't the rank that was said, the player takes the whole pile; if they were all true, the caller takes it.
Play carries on from the left of whoever was challenged. The first player to get rid of all their cards — and survive any challenge to that last play — wins.
